title: Simulation report — math/reports/*.json
description: One simulation run's complete record: reproducibility provenance (versions, hashes, seeds, exact command), aggregate results (RTP with confidence interval, hit frequency, per-tier contributions and frequencies, payout distribution, volatility), per-tier breakdown, and the pass/fail verdict against the target RTP. Numbers are reported exactly as measured — never massaged.

reportId.description: Kebab-case id of this report, e.g. 'release-rtp96-2026-08-08-a'.

kind.description: Purpose of the run: quick dev check, CI regression, full release-size run, rare-event stress (max win / ultimate tier), a bonus-buy mode, or a single tier simulated in isolation.

provenance.description: Everything needed to reproduce this run bit-for-bit.

gameVersion.description: Game package semver the run used.

mathVersion.description: Math model semver the run used.

configHash.description: sha256 of the canonical config/*.json concatenation the run used (CONVENTIONS §5).

simCodeVersion.description: Version/commit of the simulator code, e.g. a semver or git short hash.

lockfileHash.description: sha256 of the uv lockfile (uv.lock) pinning the Python environment.

seedPolicy.description: How seeds were chosen: one fixed seed, per-worker seeds derived from a master seed, or random seeds that were recorded.

seeds.description: Every RNG seed used (numpy PCG64), in worker order.

rounds.description: Total rounds simulated across all workers.

command.description: Exact command line that produced this report, e.g. 'uv run python -m slot_math.simulate --rounds 100000000 --seed 42'.

startedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the run started.

durationS.description: Wall-clock duration of the run in seconds.

results.description: Aggregate measurements over all simulated rounds.

rtp.description: Measured return-to-player as a fraction of total wagered (0.9600 = 96%).

rtpCi95.description: 95% confidence interval of the RTP as [low, high] fractions (low <= high, runtime-validated).

hitFrequency.description: Fraction of rounds with any win (0.30 = 30% of rounds pay).

contributions.description: RTP contribution of each component, as fractions of total wagered. base + scatter_pay + feature + super_feature + ultimate_feature must equal rtp within ±0.0005 (QA gate G5).

scatter_pay.description: Direct scatter pays contribution (0 when scatters do not pay).

featureFreq.description: Natural trigger frequency of each tier expressed as 1-in-N rounds (N, not a probability).

feature.description: feature triggers once per this many rounds.

super_feature.description: super_feature triggers once per this many rounds.

ultimate_feature.description: ultimate_feature triggers once per this many rounds.

retriggerRate.description: Fraction of triggered features that retriggered at least once.

avgCascades.description: Average cascades per round (0 for non-cascading games).

payoutPercentiles.description: Round-payout distribution as x-bet multiples keyed by percentile, e.g. {'p50': 0, 'p90': 1.2, 'p99': 14.5}.

additionalProperties.description: Payout at this percentile as an x-bet multiple.

maxWinHits.description: Number of simulated rounds that hit the max-win cap.

maxWinProb.description: Measured probability of hitting the max-win cap per round (maxWinHits / rounds).

variance.description: Variance of round payout in x-bet units squared.

stddev.description: Standard deviation of round payout in x-bet units.

volatilityIndex.description: Studio volatility index derived from stddev (documented in the PAR sheet; comparable across this game's profiles only).

perTier.description: Breakdown per tier (all three canonical tiers required; bonus-buy entries may add more rows with the same tierIds).

entryMode.description: Optional: whether this row measures natural triggers or a bonus-buy entry (default natural).

triggers.description: Number of times this tier triggered in the run.

rtpContribution.description: This tier's contribution to total RTP, as a fraction of total wagered.

avgPayX.description: Mean total payout of one feature instance, as an x-bet multiple.

medianPayX.description: Median total payout of one feature instance, x-bet.

p99PayX.description: 99th-percentile payout of one feature instance, x-bet (tail measure).

maxPayX.description: Largest observed payout of one feature instance, x-bet (≤ the max-win cap).

avgRounds.description: Average feature rounds played per instance, including retriggers.

retriggerRate.description: Fraction of this tier's instances that retriggered at least once.

passFail.description: Verdict against the RTP gate: |rtp − targetRtp| must be within the 99% CI half-width AND within tolerance at release size (CONVENTIONS §5).

targetRtp.description: The design target RTP for the active math profile.

tolerance.description: Maximum allowed absolute deviation |rtp − targetRtp| (0.003 at release level).

pass.description: Whether this run passes the gate. Reported honestly; a failing run ships marked FAILED-GATE.

notes.description: Evidence and caveats: measured deviation, CI half-width, anomalies, follow-ups.

fraction.description: A ratio of total wagered expressed as a fraction (0.9600 = 96%). Upper bound 10 leaves room for pathological bonus-buy measurements while catching unit mistakes.

oneInN.description: A frequency expressed as 1-in-N (N rounds per occurrence).
